skill.name: Research Skill
skill.description: Coordinate quick, standard, or extensive research across web, documentation, and code sources, then synthesize findings with confidence labels.
skill.summary: Run structured multi-source research with confidence-based synthesis.

security_audit.summary: All three external-command alerts are false positives caused by Markdown inline-code examples, not executable shell commands. Manual review of SKILL.md found plain research instructions with no prompt injection, executable code, or malicious intent. Its missing frontmatter is a packaging issue rather than a security threat.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md lacks valid frontmatter, which prevented complete static parsing.
remediation.suggestion: Add schema-compliant YAML frontmatter so future scanners can parse the file without manual review.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 106 is an inline-code documentation path inside a fenced Markdown output template. It does not invoke Ruby, a shell, or any executable command.
Line 109 formats a source file path and line number with Markdown backticks. The surrounding block is an example report, not executable shell content.
Line 52 is an inline-code documentation path in a fenced Markdown response example. No command interpreter or execution mechanism is present.

Manual review confirms that SKILL.md is plain research documentation without executable content or prompt injection. Missing frontmatter affects automated parsing but does not create a security threat.

content.user_title: Research Topics with Parallel Source Validation
content.value_statement: Single-source research can miss context, conflicts, and current evidence. This skill coordinates parallel web, documentation, and code research with confidence-based synthesis.
actual_capabilities: Selects quick, standard, or extensive workflows based on required speed and depth.
Coordinates parallel researchers across web sources, local documentation, and codebases.
Varies queries to gather official guidance, community perspectives, and implementation evidence.
Cross-validates findings and assigns high, medium, low, or conflicting confidence labels.
Reports sources, disagreements, incomplete responses, and research duration.
limitations: Web research requires network access and cannot retrieve paywalled content.
Quick mode uses limited sources and may miss nuanced or conflicting evidence.
Research quality depends on available sources and the accuracy of retrieved material.
Extensive mode can take up to ten minutes and uses more model calls.

use_cases.title: Verify Technical Facts
use_cases.description: Check a library feature against current web sources and local documentation before implementation.

use_cases.title: Compare Architecture Options
use_cases.description: Evaluate technologies from several perspectives and surface disagreements before a design decision.

use_cases.title: Prepare Supported Documentation
use_cases.description: Gather cited facts, implementation examples, and confidence labels for a technical guide.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Fact Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Use quick mode to verify whether [technology] supports [feature]. Provide the answer, sources, and confidence level.
prompt_templates.scenario: Confirm one focused fact with minimal latency.

prompt_templates.title: Standard Technical Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Use standard mode to research [technical question]. Compare web guidance with local documentation and code examples.

prompt_templates.title: Detailed Product Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [option A] and [option B]. Compare capabilities, constraints, implementation patterns, source quality, and conflicting claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Support a technology selection with multiple evidence types.

prompt_templates.title: Extensive Architecture Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use extensive mode to assess [architecture decision]. Examine alternatives, current guidance, codebase evidence, risks, conflicts, and implementation recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a comprehensive decision brief for a complex system.

output_examples.input: Quickly verify whether the selected framework supports feature X.
output_examples.output: The report gives a concise answer, lists web and documentation sources, and assigns a confidence level.

output_examples.input: Research best practices for authenticating WebSocket connections.
output_examples.output: The report summarizes cross-validated guidance, implementation notes, source links, and any unresolved disagreements.

output_examples.input: Compare two coding assistants for an engineering team.
output_examples.output: The report presents a comparative analysis, evidence-backed recommendations, source coverage, and confidence for each major finding.

best_practices: Choose the least intensive mode that still provides enough evidence for the decision.
Define the question, scope, and required recency before starting research.
Review source links and conflicting information before acting on recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not use quick mode for complex architecture or high-impact decisions.
Do not treat a single-source result as strongly validated evidence.
Do not ignore low-confidence labels, missing sources, or reported conflicts.

faq.question: Which research mode should I choose?
faq.answer: Use quick for focused facts, standard for typical technical questions, and extensive for complex comparisons or architecture decisions.

faq.question: What sources can the skill use?
faq.answer: It can research current web content, local documentation, and codebase examples when those sources are available.

faq.question: How are confidence levels assigned?
faq.answer: Confidence reflects source agreement. Three or more agreeing sources are high, while one source is low.

faq.question: What happens without network access?
faq.answer: The skill can return documentation-only results and clearly note that web sources were unavailable.

faq.question: Does the skill modify source code?
faq.answer: No. Its documented code researcher uses read and search tools to find examples and patterns.

faq.question: How long does extensive research take?
faq.answer: Extensive mode allows up to ten minutes and uses eight research agents plus a synthesis step.
